enchantHowTo: Head over to the Mysterious Altar located behind the Alchemist Store in Fortune River.
Make sure that the pan you want to enchant is the one you have equipped.
Interact with the altar and choose "Enchant my pan".
Click an ore (Aurorite, Aetherite, or Aetherium) on the left side. Enchanting will happen immediately! Make sure you don't accidentally click on an ore while scrolling through the list!
The name and stats of the resulting enchant will be shown on the right. If it's not the enchant you wanted, keep clicking ores; otherwise, close the interface.
As an alternative to taking your chances with the altar, Enchant books are available from the Traveling Merchant and Excavation Sites for some enchant types.
The weight or modifier of the ore does not affect the rarity of the enchant you might get.

overview.heading: Overview
lines: Each digsite/area (except the Museum) has its own Geode variant.
Opening a Geode rolls from that area's deposit loot table, respecting ore rarities.
Each Geode also has a flat 10% chance to drop shards.
Geodes are not deposits — they are quick single-roll nodes.
All ores obtained from Geodes will have the Crystalline modifier. Crystalline modifier is only obtainable from Geodes.

overview.heading: Overview
prose: A Treasure Chest is a special item you can uncover after finding a Treasure Map digging in various locations around the map. Equipping a map guides you to the exact spot where a hidden Treasure Chest is buried.

obtainment.heading: Obtainment
lines: After equipping a Treasure Map from your inventory, a colored arrow will appear on your screen directing you to where the Treasure Chest is located.
The arrow will turn vertical when you've reached the correct spot.
When you dig in the indicated place, text will appear on the screen that reads “You have found buried treasure!!”.
A Treasure Chest will be added to your inventory.

how-to.heading: How To
lines: To open a treasure chest, equip it from your inventory, then click the screen.
The Treasure Chest will open and the items given will appear on the right side of the screen.

usage.heading: Usage
lines: A Treasure Chest can grant different relics and ores with the Treasured modifier when opened. The loot depends on the location where the chest was obtained.

important-notes.heading: Important Notes
lines: Size Boost applies to ores inside Treasure Chests, similarly to geodes. However, unlike geodes, Luck does not apply to treasure chests.
The Treasured modifier will be applied to all ores inside the chest. This is the only way to obtain the Treasured modifier.

notes: You must pan during Meteor Shower or in the Void (or both for the best results).
2× Shards gamepass recommended.
The main goal is to fill the pan with one dig and empty it in one shake.
Equipment, gear, runes, and Museum are recommendations only. Besides 1-dig and 1-shake, you should focus on Dig Speed; Walk Speed; and Shake Speed (but no more than 950%).
The stronger your equipment mutations are, the better, however they are not necessary for this build.
Avoid Capacity in the build; you should use early game pans only.
Quality doesn't matter, so you don't need to perform full digs when panning manually.
